summary: A designer's case study built like a long lecture: one narrow column of 21px text between pastel tiles, moving from black 'Origin' pages (Swiss rock ephemera, concert tickets, typewriters) to pale-yellow 'Design' pages where looping videos explain each decision. The hero animates two isometric ticket printers; the pastel palette itself comes from ticket stock.

instances.look: Pale yellow field with two isometric line-drawn ticket machines, printing cards labelled DROMO and MONO
instances.feel: An office gadget from 1985, drawn by a Swiss engineer
instances.ux: Muted looping video; the two machines swap ticket labels and colours
instances.learn: Illustrate the source technology, not the letters: a ticket printer tells you the origin in one image and shows both subfamilies as its output

reconstruction.layout: Full-bleed 1440×751 with a 180px yellow margin each side; two machines ~490px wide, offset diagonally, the second lower right; no headline
reconstruction.typography: Words on the tickets only, ~50px Dromo Bold, rotated to the isometric plane; 'RT' stamped on each housing
reconstruction.behaviour: autoplay muted loop <video> (2000×1332); the ticket slides out while the label switches between DROMO and MONO
reconstruction.assets: Looping isometric vector animation of two ticket printers (mp4)
reconstruction.html: video.autoplay[data-ar='0.666'] in a Lay Theme (WordPress) grid

instances.look: Sticky white top strip with three centred caps links, TOP TRY BUY; never cut as a block, it shows through crop 01 as a stuck bar
instances.ux: Three fixed jumps: top, trial form, buy page
instances.learn: A three-word nav is enough on a long read

reconstruction.layout: Fixed top 0, full width, ~35px tall, white, hairline below; links centred with ~25px gaps
reconstruction.behaviour: Stays visible through the whole page

instances.look: Two short centred-column paragraphs of 21px text on yellow directly under the hero
instances.feel: A label on a museum case
instances.learn: One-paragraph origin and one-paragraph family facts are enough before a long essay

reconstruction.layout: Text column ~480px wide, left edge at 455px, second paragraph after ~15px
reconstruction.content: 'RT Dromo is a typographic line-up of vintage concert ticket typography from the 1980s…'

instances.look: Two tall pastel cards (pink for Dromo, cyan for Mono), each listing seven weights in one line per style, with the Italic at the end of the line
instances.learn: One line per weight with the italic beside it fits two subfamilies into a pair of panels, and the colours become their identity

reconstruction.layout: Each card 1080×564 centred with 180px yellow margins; 40px gap; seven lines, left at x≈225
reconstruction.typography: ~55px, leading ~1.2; RT Dromo Light to Super; Mono ditto
reconstruction.content: Style names, e.g. 'RT Dromo Medium Italic'

instances.look: 'ORIGIN / The Book' on black: short text columns between rows of Swiss punk posters and a white-on-black wall of band logos, with tiny centred credits under each image
instances.ux: Static; a link to Studio UFO
instances.learn: Black ground plus full-colour archival posters makes the source material the loudest thing on the page

reconstruction.layout: Centred 1080px, rows of 3 or 2 posters 355px wide with 15px gaps, 513px tall; 480px text column at varying offsets (x≈330 or 455); section title centred
reconstruction.typography: 21px Regular white; captions 15px Light, centred, under each image
reconstruction.content: History of the book 'Die Not hat ein Ende: The Swiss Art of Rock' and the brief

instances.look: 'The Tickets': scans of Ticketmaster and BASS stubs from the 80s, then a white-on-black reconstruction of the ticket's two type sizes on a vertical hairline pitch grid with letter pairs Ee Mm Oo Gg Rr Ss
instances.ux: Read the hunt, then see the specimen isolated from the scan
instances.learn: Follow a scan with the same letters extracted on a clean grid: readers see how the found evidence becomes a design rule

reconstruction.layout: Ticket stack 690px wide, centred; 4-up ticket grid; pitch diagram 1000×530: rows of two sizes over a comb of tick marks, each column one fixed pitch
reconstruction.typography: 21px Regular white; diagram letters are pixel-faithful ticket type
reconstruction.content: Real concert tickets (Grateful Dead, Allman Brothers, AC/DC); the double-size small-cap relationship explained
reconstruction.assets: High-resolution ticket scans, one diagram image

instances.look: 'The Typewriter': an Adler 1961 'Pica Double Gothic' catalogue sample on white paper against black, with an explanation of double-gothic faces
instances.ux: A 'here' link to the catalogue source
instances.learn: One typed sample, credited and linked, names the historic genre and earns the design's logic

reconstruction.typography: 21px Regular white; 15px Light captions; link in grey
reconstruction.content: History of typewriter faces for special purposes

instances.look: 'DESIGN' chapter opens on yellow: two square-ish video tiles, cyan 'HO' and pink 'Oo', with outlines sweeping across letters, captioned '1. Uniform Proportions, 2. Straight Segments'
instances.ux: Autoplay muted loops; no scrubbing or controls
instances.learn: Introduce the whole design with two labelled loops that double as a table of contents

reconstruction.layout: Two tiles ~530×554 side by side centred, 15px gap, in the 1080px container; caption 15px below; 480px text after
reconstruction.typography: Tile letters ~200px RT Dromo Regular; outlined layer in white with hairline
reconstruction.behaviour: mp4 loops (01-Proportions, 02-Segments): an outlined comparison glyph wipes over the solid letter

instances.look: 'Uniform Proportions': ERGO three ways (ticket large, ticket small, RT Dromo), a mono-to-proportional video, then HO/HO/no with overlaid outlines showing how similar every letter width is against RT Rondelle
instances.ux: Static and looped tiles alternate with text
instances.learn: Overlay a letter's outline on its neighbours to prove a proportion claim at a glance

reconstruction.layout: Three tiles ~355×363 with ERGO; one 1080×564 cyan video tile; 1080×677 comparison with rows of H O, H-O overlay and stems
reconstruction.typography: ~90px ERGO; ~150px comparison letters, overlays hairline outlines
reconstruction.behaviour: 03-DromoMono.mp4 loops the morph between the proportional and mono widths; the capture caught only a stem

instances.look: Four cyan tiles of centred Mono words stepping from Light to Bold line by line (Off, Dance, 12-inch, Acappella) with vertical pitch lines through the letters
instances.learn: Vertical pitch lines through a stacked sample turn a mono specimen into proof of its fixed width

reconstruction.layout: 2×2 tiles ~530×443, 20px gaps; four centred lines; vertical lines at every character pitch
reconstruction.typography: ~80px RT Dromo Mono, Light to Bold descending
reconstruction.content: Music vocabulary: Interlude, 125-BPM, Lyric, Rec, Metronome, Seq+Ext, Pitch, Aux

instances.look: Cyan tile: a ruler and four labelled rows (inches, 12pt, glyphs, units) where 'tenperinch' types letter by letter into 600-unit boxes

reconstruction.layout: Tile 1080×564; labels at left 90px, ruler across the top ~700px; ten equal boxes each ~53px wide

instances.look: 'Straight Segments': pink video tiles where each letter's flats light up as white outlines (chord; O © Ω 0 D; stratocaster / jazz-infused / beautiful riff), NOW RECORDING versus FF Din, and an aerial stadium beside an O that gave the name
instances.feel: A close-up on a single idea
instances.ux: Autoplay muted loops; one static comparison

reconstruction.layout: Tiles 1080×564 or 677 centred on yellow; 480px column of 21px text between each

reconstruction.behaviour: mp4 loops: a letter switches from solid to outline to mark straight sections, in sequence

instances.look: Single grey studio photo of the book: orange-and-black covers and open spreads
instances.feel: The payoff at the end of the story
